title: Round 2 of the OWL!
excerpt: Well folks, Round 1 was ELECTRIC, with everyone playing their asses off and leaving everything on the Board. Round 2 matchups are set — see you on the battlefield.
body: Well folks, Round 1 was ELECTRIC, with everyone playing their asses off and leaving everything on the Board. Let's see how Round 2 shapes up. Pairings have been posted on Discord — check the #owl-pairings channel for your matchup and mission. May your dice roll true, commanders.

title: Season Kickoff — Welcome Back!
excerpt: Welcome back to another gravity-altering season of the OWL! This season, with its new format, promises to light up the galaxy.
body: Welcome back to another gravity-altering season of the OWL! This season features a new round-robin format with playoffs. Sign up on Discord and get ready to fight for the OWL Cup. Six rounds, one champion.

title: Six OWLs Hit Gongaii's Great Game GT
excerpt: On Saturday, six OWLs flew out to Gongaii's Great Game for a five-game GT. The crew averaged about 2-3 — a valiant showing.
body: On Saturday, six OWLs flew out to Gongaii's Great Game for a five-game GT. The crew averaged about 2-3, and we all learned something. Shoutout to everyone who showed up and repped Overcast. More GT outings planned for the new year.

title: Hammering the Community — Week in Review
excerpt: Apologies for missing last week! I was too busy trying to do something about the Panama Papers. Hammering Community — we are on fire.
body: Apologies for missing last week! I was too busy trying to do something about the Panama Papers. All jokes aside, the community has been absolutely cooking. Three pickup games happened this week, and the league standings are getting spicy. Keep it up, commanders.
